_comment: Canonical Tailwind v4 toolchain pin for every ToolUp client. EXACT versions (no ^) — these move only by editing this file, then re-stamping consumers. check-drift.ps1 enforces that each consumer client package.json carries exactly these. update-all.ps1 -Npm rejects these names so a blanket bump can never touch them.

remove._comment: Drop these when a consumer adopts the v4 @tailwindcss/vite plugin — v4 folds @import and vendor-prefixing into the engine; the JS tailwind.config.js + postcss.config.js are deleted entirely (content auto-detection replaces the content globs).
